pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with soft, blurred edge gradients. Patches on the lateral neck are larger and more elongated compared to smaller, more compact patches visible on the shoulder area.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Thick, light-colored interstitial pathways forming a continuous topological net with junction nodes connecting three to four pathways. Line thickness is consistent across the visible neck region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Dark, low-profile silhouette along the upper neck exhibiting a subtle, low-frequency jagged edge against the out-of-focus background.
